resources.string: Keeps notification code detection available and reports its health.
Accessibility notification events are connected; the standard listener is disconnected
Notification access is disabled; tap Repair
Permission is enabled, but the listener is disconnected; tap Repair

Aggressive firmware can disconnect notification access even after the standard permissions are granted. The foreground service, disconnected-only listener repair, WorkManager watchdog and Alarm recovery are the supported resilience paths.
On HONOR MagicOS, also open Recents and swipe down on the OTP Helper card until the lock icon appears. OTP Helper is no longer hidden from Recents.
When standard notification access works, the options below are unnecessary. Open advanced recovery only if another app's OTP text is redacted or the standard listener cannot stay connected.

Reads only Android notification accessibility events to detect one-time codes. It does not inspect windows, perform gestures, read key input, or take screenshots. While the device is locked, Android may provide only the notification public version.
Enable notification reading through Accessibility events

Optional second notification-reading path defined by Android\'s public Accessibility API. Android 16 still exposes TYPE_NOTIFICATION_STATE_CHANGED and its Notification parcelable. For a locked device, a non-public notification may be replaced with its public version. This service requests no window content, gestures, key events, or screenshots.

Optional repair for Android 15 and later. Using the official Shizuku API, OTP Helper applies the RECEIVE_SENSITIVE_NOTIFICATIONS AppOp as shell/root and toggles notification-listener access so Android refreshes its trusted-listener cache. It is unnecessary when standard notification access already exposes the text, and is not required for Accessibility notification events or SMS mode.
The sensitive-notification AppOp was applied and the standard notification listener reconnected.
The sensitive-notification AppOp was applied, but listener reconnection is still pending.
Shizuku Manager is installed, but its service Binder was not received. Start Shizuku and retry.
This Shizuku API version is unsupported. Version 11 or later is required.
The Shizuku service is not running with shell or root identity.
OTP Helper does not have Shizuku permission.
A Shizuku permission request was sent. Approve it, then run the repair again.

Generate a redacted diagnostic report containing current permissions, actual notification-listener and Accessibility notification-event connections, Shizuku Manager/Binder state, service state, watchdog state, device information and recent OTP Helper logs.
